1.consolidated_definition: Diodontidae. Diodonhystrix. Pez redondo con boca aguda. Tiene dos piedras en la boca que coge los anzuelos y los rompe.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Diodontidae. Diodonhystrix. Round fish with a sharp mouth. It has two stones in the mouth that catch hooks and break them.
